profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
Hello! My name is Marielle Gomez. I am from the Bay Area, and I am Syracuse University Computer Science alumna. 

I enjoy projects in software that are innovative and that will have an impact on the world. I am a curious and empowered woman that always wants to learn more. I seek opportunities that allow me to discover more about breakthrough technology, myself, the people around me, and what we all can create.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: SQL · GraphQL · React Native · TypeScript

positions.title: Google CodeU Intern
positions.description:
-Collaborating with a Googler and a team of other hand-picked students to develop and improve an existing chat web app.  
-Currently writing the code in java, conducting code reviews and navigating complex technical challenges with the team.

positions.title: Summer Internship
positions.description:
-Was assigned to work on a joint project with SBB and their partner company, NuClimate. 
-Given an excel spreadsheet for a Pool Load Evaporation Estimator and a Pool Unit Selector and converted that spread sheet to a multi-page desktop application that would execute the same results.
-Decoded formulas on an Excel Spreadsheet.
-Converted the Excel Modules into Java. (VBA ----> Java)
-I took the formulas and designed, developed, and created  a desktop application for both companies' project.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Mexico Mission Trip - St. Mary Parish
volunteerExperiences.description:
Every June I go to Tijuana with about 60 people of all ages from St. Mary's Parish. Together we build 1-3 houses in a week. We start with a slab of concrete and work together to build a home for families in the lovely community of Tijuana, Mexico! As a Young Adult Leader and a Site Coordinator I feel so fortunate to be able to have a close bond with the other young adults and together were able to share our passion for this trip with the youth.

Here is a little taste of what this trip is about:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2X5b-ucAoZw 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0argfVIR6NA

company.name: Mexico Mission Trip - St. Mary Parish

organizations.name: Engineering and Computer Science Student Success Center Peer Mentor
organizations.description: As a peer mentor I am assigned 12 freshmen from the College of Engineering and Computer Science. I serve as their guide socially, academically, and spiritually as they get adjusted to college life.

organizations.name: Syracuse University Women's Club Volleyball Team
organizations.description: Captain of Syracuse University Women's Club Volleyball Team. We practice twice a week, have workouts once a week, and play in many tournaments during both the fall and spring semester. This year, 2018, we are heading to Denver, CO for Nationals!!
